== English Decipher comparison ==
Decipher restricts the host to your transport vehicle, specifies a character or creature target, and compares against defense value. The 2016 PC wording permits a warrior aboard an enclosed vehicle to fire. The deployment cost, firing costs and repeat-fire clause remain.

Decipher, November 1998, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/fb/Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf#page=13 Glossary Version 2.0], PDF page 13. Players Committee, Decipher Errata, official text as of 1 January 2013, PDF page 16. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf#page=16 Internet Archive].
